verdict.rationale: Snowflake's Secure Data Sharing explicitly lets accounts share selected database objects with other Snowflake accounts (or via Data Marketplace/organizations) without copying or transferring data, and without building an export pipeline, backed by RBAC governance for controlling shared access. This directly matches the story's core requirement of live, no-copy sharing across accounts/orgs. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on community corroboration of cross-account sharing specifically (community evidence is about cost/perf, not sharing), and no explicit cross-organization example beyond docs claims.
